role: D-dev-select FULL300, enriched retrospective diagnostic only

engine.name: matched_forced_decode_v1
engine.auto: fresh native single-SOT detection on each crop, then matched greedy transcription

crops.tail: clip, retain final partial view; <=2 seconds uses one view
crops.padding: only the unchanged Whisper feature extractor pads to 30 s

alignment.method: unchanged abts0_k1.token_intervals, current-query attention, median width 7
alignment.full_audio_time: crop start + local sample interval; timing is a model estimate, not gold

selection.discovery: all Latin words from union of all four local branches; no selection filters
selection.supported: at least one interior, uncapped 2-s occurrence and one interior, uncapped 4-AUTO occurrence in different physical crop bounds
selection.baseline_block: contiguous overlapping Han or Latin units, >=0.5 interval coverage

control_selection.rule: outside onset utterances; >=1 canonical Mandarin reference unit and ALL Mandarin reference units MATCH matched B0; English errors allowed and disclosed

shuffled.rule: within-dialogue nonzero circular rotation of hash-ordered selected IDs minimizing summed heard-duration mismatch
shuffled.timing: donor intervals and crops rescaled by recipient/donor heard duration; reassociate to recipient B0; no new inference
shuffled.singleton: identity pairing, flagged uninformative, retained, excluded from paired precision comparison

evaluation.lexical: primary: two independent bilingual reviewers identify literal word AND exact reference occurrence from original audio and crop; disagreement/unclear=incorrect; unchanged ABTS A1 co-optimal B0 mapping is secondary only
evaluation.adjudication: post-seal blinded template; review all target-word appearances, actual/shuffled selections, one hash-selected unfiltered occurrence per utterance, and original absent-onset audibility; no branch/support/selection flags shown; literal labels must exactly match canonical EN reference units
evaluation.timing_proxy: descriptive only, never decisive lexical ground truth
evaluation.supported_authorizes: human review of a separately frozen delivery pilot only; no automatic steering or protected-data progression
